final_gather_off.label: FINAL GATHER OFF (black diffuse textures 0/1 + cleared probe rough-specular texture 2; NOT pure diffuse only)

probe_placement.source_gate: Engine/Source/Runtime/Renderer/Private/Lumen/LumenScreenProbeGather.cpp:2755-2767 dispatches FScreenProbeGatherDebugCS only when r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Debug!=0; :2210-2215 enables ShaderPrint in that case

gather_off.observed_behavior: if (!GLumenScreenProbeGather): Textures[0]=Black, Textures[1]=Black, Textures[2]=new float RGB texture cleared to black; return ScreenSpaceDenoiserInputs. No alternate GI pipeline is selected.

probe_debug_gate.observed_behavior: FScreenProbeGatherDebugCS is only added when GVarLumenScreenProbeGatherDebug != 0; its VisualizeProbePlacement parameter is read from r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.Debug.ProbePlacement. With Debug=0 the placement CVar is inert.

probe_shaderprint.observed_behavior: Debug!=0 calls ShaderPrint::SetEnabled(true) and requests line space; the debug shader draws points/labels through ShaderPrint.

roughness_fade.observed_behavior: GLumenReflectionRoughnessFadeLength defaults to .1f and is exposed as r.Lumen.Reflections.RoughnessFadeLength.
